entry_points.text: Remap entry strips tags from source, initialises an empty monitor state and delegates; preparation retains the monitor and marks changing when events are armed.
Seal entry needs zero flags with aligned untagged ranges; sync entry accepts only async/invalidate/sync, rejects async plus sync, rounds length and treats empty as success.
No-MMU entries adjust the break within limits, audit and map with file handling, forward unmap under lock, and serialise resize under exclusive lock.
Cross-process vector I/O needs zero flags, imports local and remote vectors, runs the core engine and frees them; debug check reports the writability predicate via a read-only file.

exports.text: Relocates page-table bindings between intervals per a control descriptor and builds the destination by merging or allocating; can extend an area forward absorbing a successor.
Completes a monitored remap by sending src/dst/len notification and waiting for acknowledgement; absent monitor is a silent no-op.
No-MMU support tears down every area, propagates the executable on duplication, maps device memory by frame, and forwards cross-task access.
Walks exactly one area span after binding the walker and checking space, operations and locks.

hazards.text: Moves assume a released destination though descending stacked moves may see it populated; missing stabilisation can miss both views; rollback must repeat the same recursion decision.
Exhaustion, lost descriptors and bad classes surface as memory, fault or argument errors; overlap, task-limit overflow and index wrap fail; transient size inflation is hidden by restoring the mark.
No-MMU scatter/RAM mapping and insertion helpers fail or trap with alias invalidation as no-op; remote paths reject or truncate wrapping ranges before access.

invariants.text: Steps are bounded by remaining length and src/dst alignment; exact-sized spans move whole else descend with huge-middle split; coarse move needs platform support, no eventless tracking, empty dst and live non-leaf src; fallbacks fail unchanged.

Leaf moves preserve soft-dirty, adjust protection when dropping eventless tracking, drop pure markers, coalesce present entries and flush only if present moved; starts pull back to boundaries only when safe and cursor progress clamps negative to zero.

Delta classifies unchanged/shrink/grow and overlap compares intervals; fixed/no-unmap implies new address via unmapped allocator; charge is full size if old kept else delta; occupancy guard adds worst-case areas and pre-splits only locked keep-source after driver veto.

Validation rejects missing/sealed/misaligned areas, requires single-area containment, limits zero-length dup and retain-source on special areas, checks lock/vm limits and arithmetic, and enforces flag subset, alignment, task limits and no overlap.

Merge normalises unfaulted offsets and forbids self-merge when retained; keep-source completion clears locks and resets offsets; teardown preserves charge; shrink unmaps tail; in-place growth needs end abut without wrap/overlap and charges before merging.

Hugetlb rounds lengths, needs aligned bases and rejects reservation growth; batching needs no monitor and no helper or known-good family; sealing scans gaps, updates protection then marks sealed, with zero-page and flag/alignment rules.

No-MMU resize validates exact single-area non-shared fit then adjusts the end; frame mapping allows identity only and marks device state; vmalloc remap needs the user flag; exact lookup needs exact bounds; init builds counters, cache and trim control.

No-MMU alloc is direct slab ignoring placement args with zeroing variants clearing; translation uses direct map; reads clamp wrap; sizes follow slab/area/folio; remote access truncates with permission checks; reserves take min of free fraction and cap.

Remote copy chunks to page remainder with directional copy and fails short copies with iterator space left; vectors pin bounded chunks under read lock and unpin dirty on write; core uses stack or bounded heap, resolves task/mm and reports partial bytes.

Young test-clear flushes only if young; table free releases via callback; dumps divert sanitizer shadow and report leaves/holes; readahead initialises defaults and forwards will-need; monitor prep/fail manage changing references and report outcome.

locks.text: Stabilise reverse maps for whole-table moves or per flag; rely on address-space exclusion for src/dst ordering; nest distinct table locks with single-depth annotation and batch TLB maintenance.

Evaluate occupancy under write lock; take source exclusive before copying with per-neighbour exclusive for charge restore; bump monitor changing state under its write lock; hold top-level write from admission to execution.

Sealing takes write lock and fails on holes; sync scans under read lock dropping across flushes; user flag, unmap, truncation nesting, remote lookup and debug/dump walks use documented lock nesting and memory references.

state_machines.text: Relocation tries upper-level transfer on exact fill else descends, splits unmovable huge entries, and stops on allocation failure keeping progress.

Copy creates destination, moves tables and consults the driver hook with rollback on short transfer; pipeline runs prep, charge, exclusive copy, keep-source completion, stats, teardown and high-water restore with in-place preference.

Batched move walks intersecting areas failing on leading gaps and preserving holes; top level aligns, validates, locks killably, checks splits, dispatches, unlocks, populates locked growth and notifies the monitor.
Sync walks areas in order skipping holes except pure async, rejects invalidate on locked areas, translates to file offsets and drops the lock around each flush.
Kernel tables queue under lock, schedule background work after boot, then the worker splices privately, invalidates globally and frees each page.

structs.text: Table kinds cover normal/huge middle and upper levels; remap request aggregates descriptors, ranges, delta, flags, resize class, charge state, notification contexts and staleness/lock flags.

No-MMU keeps highest frame, heap gap, committed count, region cache with ordered tree, empty file ops and a trim-pages sysctl with zero minimum; legacy args carry prot/flags/addr/len/fd/offset; logs use a module prefix.
Kernel table reclamation holds a pending list with protecting lock and a work item bound to the drain routine.

Modes select fixed/move/retain-source with invalid/unchanged/shrink/expand classes; sync selects async/invalidate/sync; sealing takes no bits; remote caps bound heap, user pages and stack array; headers provide guard and trace markers.
